amendments: Replace old weather vector with ten physical coordinates; same vector for GAM location and AnEn.
AnEn squared distance averages within active physical groups then averages groups equally.
Retain 850-mb temperature and its surface contrast following D1 evidence and user clarification; treat as model thermal proxies, not guaranteed above-ground mixing measurements.
Use wind speed rather than direction until earth/grid vector orientation is audited.
GAM scale adds heating potential and mixing depth to product difference and revision.
Do not reselect S2 baselines; preserve earlier frozen artifacts.

anen.all_zero_distances: uniform among selected k; retain deterministic tie order
anen.distance_quantile: fraction of valid reference kth-distances <= query kth-distance; null if fewer than 40 valid reference queries
anen.ood: kth-distance > training-reference 95th percentile OR >25% active coordinates outside training min/max; diagnostic only
anen.residual_spread: 1.4826 * weighted median absolute deviation from weighted median residual
anen.residual_translation: query raw Q center + neighbor (y_audited_f - neighbor raw Q center)
anen.scaler_scope: complete eligible training vectors at exact issue minute; all seasons; never assessment
anen.scaling: median, IQR; if zero use 1.4826*MAD; if zero use population standard deviation; if zero drop coordinate; if all dropped abstain
anen.training_reference: leave-one-day-out candidate neighborhoods within training only, same exact issue and seasonal window; scaler fixed from training; not a forecast validation set

authority: User authorized S3 implementation and physically informed executive feature selection after inspecting baseline diagnostics.
evidence: Baseline outer outcomes inspected; no fresh-blind claims for subsequent development on those periods.

gam.constant_scale_ablation: eta_scale is intercept only; location unchanged
gam.penalty: lambda_mu*sum(location nonintercept beta^2)/2 + lambda_scale*sum(scale nonintercept gamma^2)/2; average day-weighted NLL; ridge on centered low-rank spline basis; intercepts unpenalized
gam.scale_bound_note: smooth bounded log-scale link resolves numerical guardrails; deliberate refinement of unbounded log-scale sketch in plan; boundary-near frequency reported
gam.season: 4 Fourier harmonics (8 columns), angle=atan2(clock_target_doy_sin,clock_target_doy_cos); shared additive cyclic term, no calendar split

solver.acceptance: finite objective and coefficients; solver success; infinity norm gradient <=1e-4; choose lowest penalized objective among valid starts, tie lowest start index
solver.failure: configuration invalid; all starts and reasons recorded; no solver change after outer results
solver.gradient_verification: central finite differences on synthetic fixtures; max scaled discrepancy <=1e-5
solver.implementation_status: specified for S3; not implemented or numerically validated in S0
solver.initial_location: weighted mean training residual intercept; all other coefficients zero
solver.initial_scale: inverse bounded-log-scale link for each start; other coefficients zero

spline.extrapolation: clip weather inputs to training min/max for spline evaluation; flag out-of-range; linear cycle ages robust-scale then clip to training min/max; retain raw Q offset without clipping
spline.identifiability: center each basis column by training day-weighted mean, discard last column of each spline block; global intercept remains
spline.scaling: scale retained centered design columns to training day-weighted RMS 1; constants dropped
spline.weather_knots: open clamped endpoints at training min/max repeated four times; one internal weighted median; if duplicate endpoint or <5 distinct values use standardized linear term; constant input dropped

gam.t_ablation: Student t CDF with nu=5; sigma is t scale, standard deviation=sigma*sqrt(5/3)

probe.training_dates: eligible 2021 days at calendar positions 0,3,6,...; label-free deterministic subsample

scope: S3 implementation and bounded fits only; S4 full nested orchestration remains a separate stage.

tuning.block_inclusion: feasibility-only; before reading losses; report excluded blocks including seasonally unsupported initial half-year
tuning.fail_policy: INSUFFICIENT_TUNING_SUPPORT; no selected model; do not relax criteria
tuning.loss_weight: equal target days over included inner blocks, equal scored issues per day
tuning.selection_level: one setting per model per outer vintage; pooled all exact issues; no per-season/per-issue hyperparameter search
tuning.support: within each model family, intersection of target-free feasibility masks across every registered configuration; solver failure invalidates whole configuration rather than dropping cases
tuning.tie_policy: all settings within tolerance of minimum; apply declared descending parameter order
